class.name: CellItemBody
class.brief_description: A [RigidBody] that represents one dropped item in the world.
class.description: Point [member item] at an item resource (a [code].tres[/code] whose script extends [code]ItemResource[/code], authored in the Items & Recipes editor tab). On entering the tree the body instances the item's [code]scene_path[/code] for visuals, and — when [member auto_build] is on — generates a single box [CollisionShape] sized to that scene's combined visual bounds, taking its mass from the item's [code]weight[/code]. [CellWorld] already routes any [RigidBody] into its [code]DynamicObjects[/code] container, so a [CellItemBody] streams with the rest of the cell. A [CellPlayerBody] walking into it shoves it (scaled by the player's speed and [member push_strength]); [method push] does the same from code and [method pickup] removes it.

method.name: get_item_id
method.description: The [code]id[/code] of the referenced [member item], or [code]""[/code]. Used to look the body up in the [ItemCategoryCatalog].

method.name: pickup
method.description: Emits [signal picked_up] with [member item] and frees the node.

method.name: push
method.description: Applies a central impulse in world space — a manual shove for interaction or explosion systems.

members.member: When on, the visual scene and a generated box collision shape are (re)built whenever [member item] changes. Turn it off to author the body's own [CollisionShape] children by hand.
The item resource this body represents.
Multiplier on the impulse a touching [CellPlayerBody] imparts. [code]0[/code] disables player pushing.

signal.name: picked_up
signal.description: Emitted by [method pickup] just before the node is freed.
